svg.title: Why CI can change when your code does not
svg.desc: An upstream action moves its v2 tag from commit A to B: without a lockfile the next CI run can execute B and break, while an onboarded workflow keeps running locked commit A until a reviewed update changes the lock.
svg.text: Same project. Same workflow. Still using build@v2.

g.text: Upstream moves v2: commit A → commit B

svg.text: Called reusable workflows use their own repo's lockfile.
